text:
The abstract indicates that the study focuses on direct impacts of electricity consumption, GDP, trade openness, urbanization, and life expectancy on ecological footprint, with quantile regression showing electricity consumption and GDP increase EF while trade and urbanization reduce EF. It does not examine any interaction effects involving technological innovation, nor does it posit that urbanization combined with tech innovation moderates the electricity‑EF relationship. Therefore, the candidate hypothesis is not the main hypothesis supported by the study.

VERDICT: REJECT
